id: 04_LMG -- Stop Burnout with Routine Laser Maintenance Kiser
title: 一颗螺栓引发的连锁故障
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/04_LMG -- Stop Burnout with Routine Laser Maintenance Kiser.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/04_LMG -- Stop Burnout with Routine Laser Maintenance Kiser/src.py

points.K12: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
points.K14: 按厂家要求的周期维护

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排多米诺骨牌旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of dominoes and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 一颗螺栓，能引出多大的故障？
overlay: 一颗螺栓引发的连锁故障

shots.scene: 螺栓、镜片、水管、喷嘴四个图标连成一串
shots.prompt_en: Four icons linked in a chain: a bolt, a cracked lens, a melted tube and a nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 今天跟着烧坏的零件，一件件看。

shots.scene: 老周和老李坐在桌边，桌上摆着几样烧坏的零件
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer sit at a black table with several damaged laser parts laid out.
shots.narration: 老周请维修负责人老李讲一次故障。

shots.scene: 老李拿起黄铜镜座，老周凑近看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer picks up a brass mirror mount with bare hands while the older man leans in.
shots.narration: 零件都是从一台二氧化碳激光器上拆下来的。

shots.scene: 一排多米诺骨牌，第一块被轻轻碰倒
shots.prompt_en: A row of dominoes; the first one is gently tipped and the rest start to fall. No people.
shots.narration: 故障就像多米诺骨牌。

shots.scene: 桌上摆着镜座、橙色镜片、喷嘴、弯折的水管
shots.prompt_en: On a black table: a brass mirror mount, an orange lens, a copper nozzle and a bent brown water tube. No people.
shots.narration: 一件事引出另一件事，一连串损坏。

shots.scene: 示意图：激光器谐振腔两端各有一面镜子，一端透出光束
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a laser resonator with a mirror at each end and a beam coming out through one of them. No people.
shots.narration: 这是输出耦合镜，光束从这里射出。

shots.scene: 示意图：腔内的光一小部分穿过输出镜
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: most of the light bounces inside the resonator and a smaller part passes through the output mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 只有一部分光，约30%从它透出来。

shots.scene: 老李拿起一个铜色短筒护罩，比划它在镜座前的位置
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a short copper-colored shroud and shows where it sits in front of the mirror mount.
shots.narration: 输出镜前面有一个保护护罩。

shots.scene: 护罩侧面一颗螺栓一点点退出来
shots.prompt_en: Animation: a bolt on the side of the shroud slowly backs out. No people.
shots.narration: 固定它的螺栓，日久松了退了出来。

shots.scene: 螺栓旁的热浪图标
shots.prompt_en: Heat wave icons around the loosening bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 也可能是受热以后退出来的。

shots.scene: 护罩滑落，挡在输出镜前面
shots.prompt_en: Animation: the shroud slips down and ends up in front of the output mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 护罩掉下来，正好挡在镜前。

shots.scene: 光束打在护罩上，碎屑向回飞溅
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the laser beam hits the fallen shroud and debris sprays back toward the mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 光束打在护罩上，碎屑溅回镜面。

shots.scene: 老李举起橙色输出镜，指着上面一道裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up an orange output lens and points at a crack in it.
shots.narration: 输出镜就这样裂开了。

shots.scene: 镜片侧面特写，内部晶体里有细裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Side close-up of the orange lens showing fine cracks inside the crystal. No people.
shots.narration: 从侧面看，里面的晶体也裂了。

shots.scene: 示意图：谐振腔内压力低，外面是大气
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: inside the resonator the pressure is lower, outside is normal air, the lens sits between them. No people.
shots.narration: 输出镜还是谐振腔的压力边界。

shots.scene: 腔内气压表低于外面
shots.prompt_en: A gauge icon inside the resonator reading lower than the gauge outside. No people.
shots.narration: 腔里的气压，低于大气压。

shots.scene: 镜片向内碎裂，空气涌入的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the lens implodes inward and outside air rushes into the resonator. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片一内爆，腔体就直通大气。

shots.scene: 风机卡住、电源冒烟两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a jammed roots blower and a power supply with smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 罗茨风机会卡死，电源可能烧掉。

shots.scene: 巨大的警告三角
shots.prompt_en: A large warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 那就是灾难性的故障。

shots.scene: 老李拿起一根弯折的棕色水管，指着熔化的地方
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a bent brown water tube and points at a melted spot.
shots.narration: 反射的光束还熔穿了一根冷却水管。

shots.scene: 水从破口喷出，洒到快门的电气接头上
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: water sprays from the melted tube onto the electrical fittings of a beam shutter. No people.
shots.narration: 水喷出来，洒到了快门的电气接头上。

shots.scene: 老李捏起铜喷嘴，对着光看中间的孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pinches a copper nozzle and looks through its center hole.
shots.narration: 光束本该从喷嘴孔里穿出去。

shots.scene: 喷嘴剖面图：光束偏了，打在内壁上
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of the nozzle: the beam is off-center and hits the inner wall. No people.
shots.narration: 这次它没走直线，打到了喷嘴内壁。

shots.scene: 喷嘴内壁一圈蓝紫色回火变色
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the nozzle's inner wall with a ring of blue and purple heat discoloration. No people.
shots.narration: 内壁上还能看到回火的颜色。

shots.scene: 喷嘴孔被熔化的金属封住，只剩周边几个小孔漏气
shots.prompt_en: The nozzle hole is sealed by melted metal, and only a little gas leaks out of small holes around it. No people.
shots.narration: 喷嘴孔被焊死，只有一点气漏出来。

shots.scene: 操作员图标看到切不透的板材，按下停止键
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an operator seeing a sheet that is not cut through and pressing a stop button. No people.
shots.narration: 好在操作员一发现切不动就停机了。

shots.scene: 加功率、降速两个图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, turning up power and slowing down speed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有去加功率、降速，想办法硬切。

shots.scene: 切割正常的图标打勾，切不动的图标亮黄灯
shots.prompt_en: A normal cut icon with a green check, and a failed cut icon with a yellow light. No people.
shots.narration: 切得好就没事，切不动说明有变化。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手做停止手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises both hands in a stop gesture.
shots.narration: 那就停下来，停下来看一看。

shots.scene: 镜片裂纹慢慢延伸到另一边的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the crack in the lens slowly grows all the way across. No people.
shots.narration: 要是继续切，裂纹会贯穿整片镜子。

shots.scene: 谐振腔图标打上大红叉
shots.prompt_en: A laser resonator icon with a big red X over it. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片内爆，谐振腔就报废了。

shots.scene: 护罩、输出镜、喷嘴、水管和时钟五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a shroud, an output lens, a nozzle, a short water tube and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 及时停机，只损失这几样和时间。

shots.scene: 一小段水管旁标着几枚硬币
shots.prompt_en: A short piece of water tube with a few small coins beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 那根水管，才值几分钱。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在停止标志旁，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a stop sign and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 记住：情况突然变了，就停。

shots.scene: 机器声音、火花、切口突然变化的图标，指向停止键
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sudden changes in machine sound, sparks and cut edge, all pointing to a stop button. No people.
shots.narration: 突变就是信号，先停再说。

shots.scene: 一台机器每天走得更慢的示意图，最后停下
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a machine icon gets slower day by day on a calendar and finally stops. No people.
shots.narration: 不维护，机器会一天比一天慢。

shots.scene: 机器突然冒烟罢工的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine suddenly stopping with a puff of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 最后像这次一样，突然罢工。

shots.scene: 扳手图标在大损失图标前把它挡住
shots.prompt_en: A wrench icon blocking a big damage icon before it happens. No people.
shots.narration: 例行维护，就是在酿成大祸前发现问题。

shots.section_title: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
shots.scene: 老李拿着护罩，在镜座上比划安装位置
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the shroud against the brass mirror mount to show how it is installed.
shots.narration: 护罩在例行维护时要拆下来。
overlay: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员

shots.section_title: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
shots.scene: 老李用手比划拧紧护罩侧面的螺栓
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer mimes tightening the bolt on the side of the shroud with his fingers.
shots.narration: 装回去时，螺栓一定要拧紧。

shots.section_title: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
shots.scene: 机器内部狭窄的空间里，护罩藏在深处
shots.prompt_en: Inside a cramped machine housing, the shroud sits deep in a hard-to-reach spot. No people.
shots.narration: 这个位置很难够，设计也不太好。

shots.section_title: 拆装要拧紧，请合格人员
shots.scene: 合格证图标和一把合适的扳手
shots.prompt_en: A qualification certificate icon next to the right wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要请合格人员，用合适工具来做。

shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，护罩一直松着
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by month after month while the shroud stays loose. No people.
shots.narration: 这个护罩松着放了两到五个月。

shots.scene: 维护人员按时检查，发现松动的螺栓
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a technician doing scheduled maintenance and spotting a loose bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 这种设备该更勤地维护。

shots.scene: 日历上的维护标记和打勾
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with regular maintenance marks and green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 按时维护，就能早早发现松动。

shots.section_title: 按厂家要求的周期维护
shots.scene: 老李翻开一本空白设备说明书，指着一页
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a blank equipment manual and points at a page.
shots.narration: 原厂要求每运行1000小时维护一次。
overlay: 按厂家要求的周期维护

shots.section_title: 按厂家要求的周期维护
shots.scene: 一个太阳图标的机器慢慢走表，日历翻过半年
shots.prompt_en: A machine with a sun icon whose hour counter turns slowly while a calendar flips through six months. No people.
shots.narration: 只开一班，大约半年一次。

shots.section_title: 按厂家要求的周期维护
shots.scene: 两个10小时班接力，日历上标出六周
shots.prompt_en: Two ten-hour shift icons side by side, and a calendar with a mark six weeks ahead. No people.
shots.narration: 一天开20小时，大约六周就到期。

shots.scene: 老周站在忙碌的车间里，指着运转的机器摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in a busy workshop pointing at a running machine and shaking his head.
shots.narration: 老周说：生产这么忙，不想停机。

shots.scene: 小镜片图标旁一个巨大的警告三角
shots.prompt_en: A small lens icon next to a huge warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 零件不贵，后果却可能是灾难性的。

shots.scene: 日历上两天被划掉，再加一个扳手和时钟
shots.prompt_en: Two days crossed out on a calendar, then a wrench icon and a clock showing a few hours. No people.
shots.narration: 等两天、修几小时，再重新调机。

shots.scene: 扳手图标护住一台正常运转的机器
shots.prompt_en: A wrench icon shielding a machine that keeps running normally. No people.
shots.narration: 例行维护，防停工也防大故障。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现骨牌、护罩、镜片、水管、喷嘴五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: dominoes, a shroud, a cracked lens, a melted tube and a nozzle.
shots.narration: 护罩一松，镜裂、管穿、嘴焊死。

shots.scene: 停止标志和扳手图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A stop sign icon next to a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 切不动就停，别加功率硬切。

shots.scene: 合格证、日历、1000小时计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a qualification certificate, a calendar and a run-hour counter. No people.
shots.narration: 合格人员拧紧装好，每1000小时维护。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老周、老李在桌边挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the older man and the facility engineer at the table.
shots.narration: 连锁故障就讲到这里，下次见！
